subject.title: [Feature]: Add Korean (ko) language support to Control UI and AI agent

question: Should OpenClaw add an agent-wide same-language response policy and automatic Korean-aware search behavior, or keep this issue scoped to the already-shipped Control UI locale?
rationale: The remaining request changes default agent behavior and web_search parameter selection across conversations, so code inspection alone cannot choose the permanent product policy safely.

options.title: Split And Require Proof
options.body: Keep this issue open for a scoped agent-language policy decision, requiring a redacted Korean transcript or live run plus focused prompt/search tests before implementation.

options.title: Scope To UI Only
options.body: Treat Korean Control UI localization as complete and close the remaining agent-language/search-default request as not planned unless a new policy proposal is filed.

options.title: Approve Global Policy
options.body: Approve a core prompt/search change that preserves explicit user instructions and mixed-language conversations while adding Korean and non-Korean regression coverage.

recommendation.title: Split And Require Proof
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open for a scoped agent-language policy decision, requiring a redacted Korean transcript or live run plus focused prompt/search tests before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is closest to core agent prompt and web_search product behavior, and this account has recent adjacent history plus issue-discussion presence.
